--additional-mutating-webhook-configs-to.help: comma-separated list of additional MutatingWebhookConfigurations for which manager should rotate certs

--additional-validating-webhook-configs-.help: comma-separated list of additional ValidatingWebhookConfigurations for which manager should rotate certs

--addr.help: set listening address of the server (e.g., [ip]:<port> for TCP)

--admission-events-involved-namespace.help: emit admission events for each violation in the involved objects namespace, the default (false) generates events in the namespace Gatekeeper is installed in. Admission events from cluster-scoped resources will still follow the default behavior

--api-cache-dir.help: The directory where audit from api server cache are stored, defaults to /tmp/audit

--audit-channel.help: (alpha) Channel name for exporting audit violation messages. Defaults to audit-channel

--audit-chunk-size.help: (alpha) Kubernetes API chunking List results when retrieving cluster resources using discovery client. defaulted to 500 if unspecified

--audit-connection.help: (alpha) Connection name for exporting audit violation messages. Defaults to audit-connection

--audit-events-involved-namespace.help: emit audit events for each violation in the involved objects namespace, the default (false) generates events in the namespace Gatekeeper is installed in. Audit events from cluster-scoped resources will still follow the default behavior

--audit-from-cache.help: audit synced resources from internal cache, bypassing direct queries to Kubernetes API server

--audit-interval.help: interval to run audit in seconds. defaulted to 60 secs if unspecified, 0 to disable

--audit-match-kind-only.help: only use kinds specified in all constraints for auditing cluster resources. if kind is not specified in any of the constraints, it will audit all resources (same as setting this flag to false)

--authorization-mode.help: Use barebones functionality, avoiding dependencies on the Kubernetes API. This allows the binary to serve as a standalone authorization server.

--bundle.help: Install a policy bundle (may be specified multiple times)

--cert-dir.help: The directory where certs are stored, defaults to /certs

--cert-service-name.help: The service name used to generate the TLS cert's hostname. Defaults to gatekeeper-webhook-service

--client-ca-name.help: name of the certificate authority bundle to authenticate the Kubernetes API server requests against

--client-cn-name.help: expected CN name on the client certificate attached by apiserver in requests to the webhook

--constraint-violations-limit.help: limit of number of violations per constraint. defaulted to 20 violations if unspecified

--debug-use-fake-pod.help: Use a fake pod name so the Gatekeeper executable can be run outside of Kubernetes

--default-create-vap-binding-for-constra.help: (beta) Create VAPBinding resource for constraint of the template containing VAP-style CEL source. Allowed values are false: do not create Validating Admission Policy Binding, true: create Validating Admission Policy Binding.

--default-create-vap-for-templates.help: (beta) Create VAP resource for template containing VAP-style CEL source. Allowed values are false: do not create Validating Admission Policy unless generateVAP: true is set on constraint template explicitly, true: create Validating Admission Policy unless generateVAP: false is set on constraint template explicitly.

--default-wait-for-vapb-generation.help: (beta) Wait time in seconds before generating a ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding after a constraint CRD is created.

--disable-cert-rotation.help: disable automatic generation and rotation of webhook TLS certificates/keys

--disable-enforcementaction-validation.help: disable validation of the enforcementAction and scopedEnforcementActions field of a constraint

--dry-run.help: Preview changes without applying (does not require cluster access)

--emit-admission-events.help: (alpha) emit Kubernetes events for each admission violation

--emit-audit-events.help: (alpha) emit Kubernetes events with detailed info for each violation from an audit

--enable-generator-resource-expansion.help: (beta) Enable the expansion of generator resources

--enable-manual-deploy.help: allow users to manually create webhook related objects

--enable-mutation.help: Deprecated. This used to enable the mutation feature, now it has no effect. Use --operation=mutation-webhook and --operation=mutation-status instead.

--enable-referential-rules.help: Enable referential rules. This flag defaults to true. Set this value to false if you want to disallow referential constraints. Because referential constraints read objects other than the object-under-test, they may be subject to race conditions. Users concerned about this may want to disable referential rules

--enable-remote-cluster.help: (alpha) Enable remote cluster mode where Gatekeeper operates against a target cluster specified via --kubeconfig while running in the local cluster. Mutually exclusive with --debug-use-fake-pod.

--enable-tls-healthcheck.help: enable probing webhook API with certificate stored in certDir

--enable-violation-export.help: (alpha) Enable exporting violations to external systems

--enforcement-action.help: Override enforcement action (deny, warn, dryrun). Note: 'scoped' is not supported in this release.

--external-data-provider-response-cache-.help: TTL for the external data provider response cache. Specify the duration in 'h', 'm', or 's' for hours, minutes, or seconds respectively. Defaults to 3 minutes if unspecified. Setting the TTL to 0 disables the cache.

--health-addr.help: The address to which the health endpoint binds.

--host.help: the host address the webhook server listens on. defaults to all addresses.

--insecure.help: Allow plain HTTP catalog URLs (not recommended)

--library-path.help: Path to the gatekeeper-library repository root

--log-denies.help: log detailed info on each deny

--log-file.help: Log to file, if specified. Default is to log to stderr.

--log-level.help: Minimum log level. For example, DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR. Defaulted to INFO if unspecified.

--log-level-encoder.help: Encoder for the value of the log level field. Valid values: [`lower`, `capital`, `color`, `capitalcolor`], default: `lower`

--log-level-key.help: JSON key for the log level field, defaults to `level`

--log-mutations.help: Enable detailed logging of mutation events

--log-stats-audit.help: (alpha) log stats metrics for the audit run

--max-serving-threads.help: cap the number of threads handling non-trivial requests, -1 caps the number of threads to GOMAXPROCS. Defaults to -1.

--metrics-addr.help: The address the metric endpoint binds to.

--opa-auth-token-file.help: set path of auth token file where the bearer token for opa is stored in format 'token = "<auth token>"'

--opa-ca-file.help: set path of the ca crts which are used in addition to the system certs to verify the opa server cert

--opa-url.help: set URL of OPA API endpoint

--otlp-metric-interval.help: interval to read metrics for opentelemetry exporter. defaulted to 10 secs if unspecified

--output.help: Output path for the generated catalog

--port.help: port for the server. defaulted to 443 if unspecified

--pprof-port.help: port for pprof profiling. defaulted to 6060 if unspecified

--readiness-retries.help: The number of resource ingestion attempts allowed before the resource is disregarded.  A value of -1 will retry indefinitely.

--shutdown-delay.help: Time in seconds the controller runtime shutdown gets delayed after receiving a pod termination event. Prevents failing webhooks on pod shutdown. default: 10

--stackdriver-metric-interval.help: interval to read metrics for stackdriver exporter. defaulted to 10 secs if unspecified

--stackdriver-only-when-available.help: Only attempt to start the stackdriver exporter if credentials are available

--sync-vap-enforcement-scope.help: (beta) Synchronize ValidatingAdmissionPolicy enforcement scope with Gatekeeper's admission validation scope. When enabled, VAP resources inherit match criteria, conditions, and namespace exclusions from Gatekeeper's webhook configuration, Config resource and exempt namespace flags. This ensures consistent policy enforcement between Gatekeeper and VAP but triggers constraint template reconciliation on scope changes in Config resource or webhook configuration. This flag is deprecated and will be removed in Gatekeeper v3.24.

--tls-cert-file.help: set path of TLS certificate file. Only works in authorization mode.

--tls-private-key-file.help: set path of TLS private key file. Only works in authorization mode.

--webhook-name.help: domain name of the webhook, with at least three segments separated by dots. defaulted to mutation.styra.com if unspecified

expand.help: expand allow for testing generator resource expansion configs by expanding a generator resource and outputting the resultant resource(s)

gator.help: gator is a suite of authorship tools for Gatekeeper

generate-catalog.help: Generate a policy catalog from gatekeeper-library

policy.help: Manage Gatekeeper policies from the policy library

search.help: Search available policies in the catalog

upgrade.help: Upgrade installed policies to latest versions

verify.help: verify suites of tests on Gatekeeper Constraints
